book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Yesu u yinɑnɑɑn ɡɑri mɔ̀
Ye Yesu u ɡɑri yi ɡeruɑ u kpɑ u doonɑ Gɑlilen di u dɑ Yudeɑn berɑ ɡiɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yuudɛnin dɑɑrun ɡuru ɡiɔ.
Tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ nùn swĩi mi, mɑ u ben bɑrɔbu bɛkiɑ.
Fɑlisi ɡɑbɑ nɑ win mi, bu kɑ win lɑɑkɑri mɛɛri bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɛsɛn woodɑ yɑ wurɑ tɔnu u win kurɔ yinɑ ɡɑri bɑɑyiren sɔ̃?
Yesu u nɛɛ, i ǹ ɡɑrire Gusunɔn ɡɑri sɔɔ mɑ “Toren di Tɑkɑ kowo u bu kuɑwɑ durɔ kɑ kurɔ.”
Mɑ yi kpɑm nɛɛ, “Yen sɔ̃nɑ, durɔ u koo win tundo kɑ win mɛro deri kpɑ wi kɑ win kurɔ bɑ n mɑninɛ kpɑ be yiru kpuro bu ko wɑsi tee.”
Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔmbu yiru mɑ n kun mɔ tɔn turo. Ǹ n mɑn nɑ, tɔnu u ku kɑrɑnɑ ye Gusunɔ u mɛnnɑ.
Fɑlisibɑ bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ Mɔwisi u woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, durɔ u yinɑnɑɑn tireru yore kpɑ u de win kurɔ u doonɑ.
Yesu u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, Mɔwisi derɑ i bɛɛn kurɔbu yinɑmɔ bɛɛn woo bɔbunun sɔ̃. Adɑmɑ sɑɑ toren di ɡɑri yi, yi ǹ sɑ̃ɑ mɛ.
Nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, wi u win kurɔ yinɑ mɑ n kun mɔ sɑkɑrɑrun sɔ̃, mɑ u kurɔ kpɑo suɑ, u sɑkɑrɑru kuɑwɑ.
Win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ n sɑ̃ɑ durɔ kɑ win kurɔn suunu sɔɔ, n burɑm bo bu ku suɑnɑ.
Yesu u nɛɛ, tɔmbu kpuro bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu ɡɑri yi suɑ mɑ n kun mɔ be Gusunɔ u yen dɑm wɛ̃.
Domi ɡɑbun mi mɑrumɑrɑ, ɡɑbu mɑɑ tɔmbɑ bɑ bu kuɑ mɛ, ɡɑbu mɑɑ kpɑm, Gusunɔn bɑndun sɔ̃nɑ bɑ ǹ kurɔ suɑmɔ. Wi u koo kpĩ u ɡɑri yi suɑ, u suo.
Yesu u bibu kɑnɑru kuɑ
Tɔmbɑ kɑ bii piiminu nɑ Yesun mi, u kɑ bu nɔmɑ sɔndi kpɑ u bu kɑnɑru kuɑ, ɑdɑmɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ tɔn be ɡerusi.
Yerɑ Yesu nɛɛ, i de bii piiminu nu nɑ nɛn mi, i ku bu yinɑri. Domi Gusunɔ u bɑndu swĩi tɔmbun sɔ̃ be bɑ kɑ bu weenɛ.
U bu nɔmɑ sɔndi mɑ u doonɑ min di.
Gobiɡii ɡoon ɡɑri
Durɔ ɡoo nɑ Yesun mi, u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, ɡeɑ mbɑ kon ko n kɑ wɑ̃ɑru te tɑ ku rɑ kpe wɑ.
Yesu nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ mɑn ɡeɑn kobun ɡɑri bikiɑmɔ. Tɔn turowɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡeo. À n kĩ ɑ wɑ̃ɑru te tɑ ku rɑ kpe wɑ ɑ woodɑbɑ swĩiyɔ.
U nɛɛ, yen yerɑ̀. Yesu u nɛɛ, ɑ ku tɔnu ɡo, ɑ ku sɑkɑrɑru ko, ɑ ku ɡbɛni, ɑ ku ɡoo ɡɑri mɑni,
ɑ wunɛn tundo kɑ wunɛn mɛro bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛyɔ, kpɑ ɑ wunɛn tɔnusi kĩɑ nɡe wunɛn tii tii.
Aluwɑɑsi wi, u nɛɛ, yeni kpurowɑ nɑ swĩi. Mbɑ n mɑɑ mɑn tie.
Yesu nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n kĩ ɑ yibu, ɑ doo ɑ dɔrɑ kpuro ye ɑ mɔ, kpɑ ɑ yen ɡobi sɑ̃ɑrobu bɔnu kuɑ, kɑɑ n dukiɑ mɔ wɔllɔ, kpɑ ɑ nɑ ɑ mɑn swĩi.
Adɑmɑ ye ɑluwɑɑsi wi, u nuɑ mɛ, u doonɑ kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu domi win dukiɑ yɑ kpɑ̃.
Yerɑ Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, n sɛ̃ ɡem ɡem dukiɑɡii u kɑ bɑn te Gusunɔ u swĩi wurɑ.
Yen sɛ̃sɔ ɡɑ kpɑ̃ n kere yooyoo ɡu du yɑburɑn wɛ̃rɔ ɡu yɑri.
Ye bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ, bɑ biti soorɑ ɡem ɡem, mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, wɑrɑ u koo den fɑɑbɑ wɑ.
Yesu bu mɛɛrɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, tɔmbun miyɑ n ǹ koorɔ ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɑri ni Gusunɔ u kpɑnɛ.
Yerɑ Piɛɛ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n wee bɛsɛ sɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu kpuro deri sɑ nun swĩi. Mbɑ n ko n ko bɛsɛɡiɑ.

Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, sɑnɑm mɛ Tɔnun Bii u ko n sɔ̃ win sinɑ ɡɔni yiikoɡiɑn wɔllɔ hɑnduniɑ kpɑɑ sɔɔ, bɛɛ wɔkurɑ yiru be i mɑn swĩi bɛɛn tii i ko n sɔ̃ sinɑ ɡɔni wɔllɔ i kɑ Isirelibɑn bwesenu wɔkurɑ yiru siri.

Mɑ bɑɑwure wi u win yɛnu deri, ǹ kun mɛ wɔnɔbu, ǹ kun mɛ sesubu, ǹ kun mɛ tundo, ǹ kun mɛ mɛro, ǹ kun mɛ bibu, ǹ kun mɛ ɡbeɑ nɛn yĩsirun sɔ̃, u koo yen kɔsire wɑ dɑbi dɑbinu, kpɑ u wɑ̃ɑru te tɑ ku rɑ kpe tubi di.
Adɑmɑ dɑbiru be bɑ tɛ̃ sɑ̃ɑ ɡbiikobu bɑ koo ko birukobu, mɑ dɑbiru be bɑ tɛ̃ sɑ̃ɑ birukobu bɑ koo ko ɡbiikobu.
